title: Desktop App Development
goal: Build and verify a desktop app without shipping broken UI, packaging, or installer behavior
current_state: The product direction is known, but the app still needs implementation evidence and packaging checks
recent_progress: Target platform and packaging format are known
constraints: Do not change installer signing or release channels without human confirmation
Keep each UI change small enough to verify with a screenshot or smoke test
verifiers: Primary workflow works from a clean state
Desktop and narrow window screenshots show no obvious layout break
Packaging command completes or reports a clear blocker

browser_verification: Use screenshots for any webview or local preview surface
forbidden_areas: Do not publish installers without human confirmation
harness.local_secrets: Do not read signing keys or local secrets unless the user explicitly asks.
cost_strategy: Use stronger models for architecture and packaging failures
Use cheaper models for formatting and checklist passes
